ideas.name: 8-K download demand predicts lower returns
ideas.claim: Monthly demand for 8-K filings (EDGAR server log downloads) predicts negative abnormal return the following month; long/short portfolio on 8-K downloads.
ideas.quote: demand for 8-K predicts a significant and negative abnormal return of -12 basis points (bps) for the following month using Fama-Macbeth regression and controlling for media coverage and a set of risk factors.

rules.entry: sort stocks by monthly 8-K downloads from EDGAR log files; short high demand, long low demand

ideas.claimed_result: -12 bps per month (Fama-MacBeth); long/short 8-K portfolio alpha -0.48% per month; 10-K demand long/short 0.81% per month; EDGAR logs 2003-2016

ideas.name: Price run-up before SEC filing predicts post-filing drift
ideas.claim: Stocks ranked on price run-up in 30 minutes before EDGAR acceptance timestamp; highest run-up continues up after release.
ideas.quote: if the stocks are ranked into 5 portfolios based on the price run-up prior to filing release, for all form types, the events with the highest run-up would also have the highest price increase post filing release.

rules.entry: rank into 5 portfolios on return in the 30 minutes before the EDGAR acceptance timestamp; buy highest run-up
rules.filters: filing type (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q may go both ways)

ideas.claimed_result: highest run-up quintile has highest post-release gain; 11.5 million events 1994-2017 per search snippet; no number copied

ideas.name: Insider purchases far below 52-week high
ideas.claim: Open-market insider purchases (Form 4 code P) in US microcaps are followed by abnormal return rising with distance below 52-week high.
ideas.quote: are followed by a first-day abnormal return that rises steeply with the stock's distance below its 52-week high

rules.entry: buy on Form 4 open-market purchase filing, sorted by distance below 52-week high
rules.exit: reaction runs two to three sessions
rules.filters: microcap size band; distance below 52-week high

ideas.claimed_result: first-day abnormal return 4.13% farthest quintile vs 0.86% nearest (as stated on abstract page); 2018-2024
